name: Haus Alpenblick
beschreibung:
Peacefully and sunnily located in the mountain village of Gerlos, Haus Alpenblick is a friendly alpine holiday base. Well-tended rooms ensure a restful break amidst the peaks.

The Zillertal Arena cable cars, winter walking paths, and hiking bus stops are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Alpenblick in Gerlos provides cosy guestrooms and restful relaxation in the Zillertal Arena.
